description:
Which employers have filed a layoff (WARN) notice in Minnesota since 2023, closures, and stated headcounts. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Who has announced layoffs in the Twin Cities?"
- "Which sites are closing?"

address.description: A street address inside the seven-county metro, to answer about ONE property instead of the whole market. Include the city after a comma when the street name is common — 'Grand Ave' exists in several of these cities.

cut.description: all: every filing since 2023; closures: letters that close a site; counted: with a stated headcount; placed: on a parcel in the seven counties. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: layoff_notices
title: Layoff Notices
